name: Elena Rostova
shortBiography: Pioneered kernel-level eBPF behavioral telemetry frameworks protecting multi-tenant cloud workloads at hyper-scale.
fullBiography: Elena oversees engineering and platform architecture at SPECTRE DEFEND. With deep roots in distributed systems security and cloud-native hypervisors, she led the development of SPECTRE DEFEND's sub-12ms quarantine pipeline. Previously, she directed kernel engineering for global hyperscale cloud providers.
